question: If (p + q) = 5 and pq = 18, then what is the value of p³ + q³ ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use the algebraic identity: p³ + q³ = (p + q)³ − 3pq(p + q)

Given **(p + q) = 5** and **pq = 18**.

p³ + q³ = (5)³ − 3 × 18 × 5

p³ + q³ = 125 − 270 = −145

**∴ The correct answer is -145.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sum of variables (p + q) = 5

Product of variables (pq) = 18

**Formula used:**

p³ + q³ = (p + q)(p² − pq + q²) OR p³ + q³ = (p + q)³ − 3pq(p + q)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/73ebbfc233ad4c512469af7e042f56ff0c92d5d7e7ccac55956d05484985d1cc.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ p³ + q³ = (p + q)³ − 3pq(p + q)

⇒ p³ + q³ = (5)³ − 3 × (18) × (5)

⇒ p³ + q³ = 125 − 270

⇒ p³ + q³ = −145

Therefore, the correct option is (3).

**∴ The correct answer is -145.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Sum of Cubes Identity

The expression can also be written as: p³ + q³ = (p + q)(p² − pq + q²).

Difference of Cubes Identity

For subtraction: p³ − q³ = (p − q)(p² + pq + q²) = (p − q)³ + 3pq(p − q).

Square Identity

(p + q)² = p² + q² + 2pq. This is used to find p² + q² when individual values are needed.</p
